text: Supervised learning uses labelled examples to learn a mapping from inputs to target outputs.
A train-validation-test split helps separate model fitting, model selection, and final evaluation.
Accuracy can be misleading when a classification dataset has a severe class imbalance.
Precision measures the share of predicted positives that are true positives.
Recall measures the share of actual positives that the model correctly identifies.
Retrieval-augmented generation supplies relevant external passages to a language model at response time.
A retrieval system can fail when source documents are outdated, poorly chunked, or weakly matched to the query.
Grounding generated answers in retrieved evidence can improve traceability but does not guarantee correctness.
Prompt injection attempts to influence a model through instructions embedded in user input or retrieved content.
AI governance can include documented intended use, evaluation, human oversight, monitoring, and incident handling.
Performance should be assessed across relevant user groups when errors may affect groups differently.
Data drift occurs when the distribution of incoming data changes relative to the data used during development.
